budget.note: No memory is reserved. Free-memory snapshots can change and omit reclaimable memory or process limits. Default: min(25% host free, 12.5% host total, 1 GiB); dedicated GPU also uses at most 50% device free. GPU is capped at the CLI 512 MiB heap. Unified memory is counted once. Overrides replace the free-memory/headroom policy and may exceed the free snapshot; they remain subject to known total physical memory and the GPU cap. They are user assumptions, not verified available capacity.

sizing.predictionNote: Idealized independent/uniform-hash estimate, not a guaranteed observed false-positive rate. expected-items is a caller-supplied expected DISTINCT count per shard; the filter does not count exact distinct keys. Exceeding it can increase false positives. Sizing does not establish GPU usability.

timingNote: Workload wall time has millisecond resolution and includes allocation, key generation, insertion, query, reduction and one diagnostic print. GPU time includes dispatch/synchronization; isolated kernel time and occupancy are not measured. Process wall time includes warmup and runtime startup, excludes build. Null throughput means below clock resolution.
topology: Independent filters per shard; sequential inserts within each shard. No shared bit writes or single global filter.
